caption:
Your hands are dropping. But the blow that finishes you only lands after the guard comes down — not one moment before. (Galatians 6:9 devotional)

Being this tired feels like a verdict, as if exhaustion already means you've lost the fight. But "lose heart" pictures a boxer letting his hands fall from his chin — the weariness isn't the loss; only letting go of the direction is. The tears you've sown are proof you haven't quit, and in Christ you're held up even when you're spent, because the harvest is guaranteed to come in its own season.
